hero_background.usage: Hero section background with dark overlay

property_kyoto.usage: Featured property card or heritage section

investor_lifestyle.usage: About us or Investor relations section

icons.size: w-5 h-5 for UI, w-8 h-8 for features

structure: Hero: Full-screen video/image with 'Zen' typography and clear CTA.
Bento Grid: Featured properties (Mix of tall and wide cards).
How It Works: 3-step process with minimalist line icons.
landing_page.special_instructions: Use parallax scrolling for the background images. Ensure the 'Connect Wallet' button is visible but not aggressive.

marketplace.card_style: Image top (aspect-video), Data middle (Yield, Price, Location), Action bottom (Buy Token).
marketplace.filters: Clean checkbox lists, price range slider with gold accent.

property_detail.layout: Hero Image Grid (1 main, 3 small). Sticky sidebar for 'Buy Token'. Main content: Description, Location (Map), Financials (Charts).
property_detail.charts: Use Recharts. Line color: #181B38 (Primary) or #10B981 (Success). Minimalist axis.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (collapsed on mobile). Main area: Summary cards (Total Value, Yield), Portfolio Table, Transaction History.
dashboard.visuals: Use 'Glass' cards for summary metrics. Table rows should have hover effects.

universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients on text unless it's a very subtle gold shimmer.
Do NOT center align long text blocks. Left align for readability.
Use 'tracking-tight' for all headings larger than 24px.
Buttons should have a subtle 'active' state (scale 0.98).
All images must have 'object-cover' and rounded corners consistent with the theme.
Use 'gap-8' or 'gap-12' for section spacing to maintain the 'Zen' feel.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-trust, high-value marketplace. Quality of UI is paramount. Do not rush the CSS. Ensure padding is generous. Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. If a specific component is missing in Shadcn, build it using Tailwind primitives matching the design system.
